local data={
	-----Headhunting Permits Standard-----
	["Chartered HH Permit"]={name="Chartered HH Permit", tier=6, use="An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Chartered Headhunting].", desc="Talos-II is home to plenty of talented individuals. To satisfy the ever-increasing demand for skilled operators of Endfield Industries, the HR Division has prepared a special and temporary contingent measure for headhunting.", obtain="Acquisition Center: Bond Quota Exchange, Reward: Events"},
	["Chartered HH-10×Permit"]={name="Chartered HH-10×Permit", tier=6, use="An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 10×headhunting in [Chartered Headhunting].", desc="When tales of the Endministrator's heroic deeds spread to a place, Endfielders at the HR Division would be quickly overwhelmed with work. When the hectic OT blows over, new faces will show up in the roster of Endfield operators.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["New Horizons HH-10×Permit"]={name="New Horizons HH-10×Permit", tier=6, use="An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 10×headhunting in [New Horizons Headhunting].", desc="To familiarize the freshly awakened Endministrator with the many ongoing projects of Endfield, the HR Division planned a special recruitment event.", obtain="Reward: Events"},
	["Basic HH Permit"]={name="Basic HH Permit", tier=6, use="An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Basic Headhunting].", desc="Endfield Industries has many connections and resources throughout Talos-II. Whenever the Endfield HR Division starts headhunting in a particular sector of the industry, someone will always answer the call.", obtain="Reward: Events"},
	["Cosmic Voice Issue Cert"]={name="Cosmic Voice Issue Cert", tier=6, use="A special Arsenal certificate. Can be used for Arsenal Issue and acquire 10 pieces of weapons.", desc="A weapon exchange certificate from Endfield. Anyone, even non-Endfielders, can use this certificate and apply for support from the Endfield Arsenal.", obtain="Reward: Events"},
